description: Hosted FactLot tool (api.factlot.com only). Builds a client-ready document by code, with no model: tx_unequal_appraisal (calc_tx_unequal_appraisal: evidence packet PDF or adjustment-grid workbook with live formulas; send registry_tx_equity_candidates' sources as context.sources to print each cited source's as-of date, URL and rights), lease_abstract (doc_abstract_lease), cam_reconciliation (calc_cam_reconciliation or _batch), debt_sizing (calc_debt_sizing), asc842_schedule (calc_lease_remeasurement_asc842), compare_proposals (calc_compare_proposals), dcf_summary (calc_dcf_pro_forma), critical_dates (calc_critical_dates; also ics: a calendar with each notice window and deadline dated on its contractual day and a reminder 30 days before; dates before today are left out unless include_past is true), tx_protest_deadline (rules_tx_property_tax_protest_deadline on tax_year, notice_delivered_date?, as_of?, or the _batch rule when arguments has items: ics, one calendar with each notice's statutory filing deadline and conservative file-by date as all-day events, reminders 30 and 7 days before the file-by date, the rule's basis, status, warnings and notes in each description, and the rule's next_season dates when the requested year has passed; or pdf, a deadline sheet). Every kind but lease_abstract requires the tool's arguments: FactLot runs the tool on them and builds the document from that run only, so its numbers are FactLot's results; a result sent as input is not used (the answer's result_mismatch says whether it differs). lease_abstract takes doc_abstract_lease's arguments, or its result as input: built from a supplied result, every page says the abstract values are as supplied by the caller and FactLot did not recompute them. Caller text (title, prepared_for, citation locators, comparable ids, labels and reasons, tx_protest_deadline item ids) is printed as supplied by the caller; advice or valuation wording in it is refused (TextNotAllowed). One report per request (one report_create per MCP batch). Returns download_url (works 24 hours), expires_at, bytes, sha256, filename and billed (true when this request counted against the month; every refusal has billed: false); inline: true also returns files under 1 MiB as base64. Counts against reports_per_month (free: 3 a month per IP address; Pro 50; Team 1,000); input errors are free.

arguments.description: The tool's arguments. Required for every kind but lease_abstract: FactLot runs the tool on them and builds the document from that run only. tx_protest_deadline: rules_tx_property_tax_protest_deadline's (tax_year, notice_delivered_date?, as_of?), or with items the _batch rule's (items: [{id, tax_year, notice_delivered_date?}], as_of?).

context.description: Optional title, prepared-for line, and citations (text only).

comparable_citations.description: tx_unequal_appraisal: citations by comparable id (or #1, #2 … for comparables without an id), for comparables whose result carries none. A citation in the result is kept; one here for the same comparable is listed beside it.

prepared_for.description: Who the report is prepared for, printed under the title.

sources.description: tx_unequal_appraisal: the `sources` of registry_tx_equity_candidates (or registry_get) as returned: each cited document_id with its title, uri, as_of and rights (ai_use, redistribution, license, attribution). The packet's Sources and rights block prints each cited source with its as-of date, URL and rights; a source sent without rights, or a right of "unknown", is printed as not stated by the publisher.

subject_citation.description: tx_unequal_appraisal: where the subject's value comes from (document_id, locator, as_of, fact_id).

title.description: Report title shown on the cover, e.g. the property or lease name. Defaults to one from the result.

format.description: xlsx, pdf, or ics (critical_dates and tx_protest_deadline). tx_protest_deadline comes as ics or pdf.

include_past.description: ics only: also put dates before today in the calendar (critical_dates: today in UTC; tx_protest_deadline: today in US Central time, and the passed tax year's dates beside next season's). By default they are left out.

inline.description: Also return the file as base64 (an embedded resource) when it is under 1 MiB.

input.description: lease_abstract only: the doc_abstract_lease result, used when arguments are not sent (each page then says the values are the caller's). For other kinds a result sent here is not used; the answer says whether it matches FactLot's run (result_mismatch).

name: report_create
title: Create a client-ready report (XLSX, PDF, ICS)
